item.title: Transformer Transformer: A Unified Model for Motion-Conditioned Robot Co-Design
item.description:
📝 Behind that result is a diffusion transformer trained on RoboTokens, a unified tokenization of robot embodiments, states, and actions. The same architecture spans embodiment spaces (wheeled bimanual, quadrupeds, humanoids) and use cases (embodiment generation, cross-embodiment control). Experiments across three design spaces show zero-shot optimization of unseen rewards and trajectories, improving performance and runtime over an evolutionary baseline.
🔗 Read more: https://transformer-transformer.github.io/

item.title: Cracking Windows Open: Porting RADV to Win32
item.description:
📝 RADV is the open source Mesa Vulkan driver for AMD GPUs. Where Faith's work established that this could be done, this project picked up the thread. The biggest open question for making this production-ready is the interface to the proprietary kernel driver.

item.title: Hooray for the Sockets Interface
item.description:
